# A Carousel's height config never reaches its slides

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

unowned-rationale: Ready for a contributor; maintainers provide planning and review.

## Context

`Neo.component.Carousel` takes `height` and `width` configs, and `examples/component/carousel` resizes the carousel with two range fields. The box grows, its slides do not: measured headless at 1440 × 900 with the carousel at 320 × 400, the box is 400 px tall while the slide area (`.neo-carousel-inner`) is 194 px, which is the inner element's 14rem minus its 15 px padding at any height.

## The Problem

`baseCls: ['neo-carousel']` (`src/component/Carousel.mjs:49-51`) puts `neo-carousel` on the component's root, and its `_vdom` gives the first child the same class (`{cls: ['neo-carousel'], cn: [btn-bar, inner]}`). The stylesheet's `.neo-carousel` rule (`resources/css/src/component/Carousel.css`: `height: 14rem; padding: 15px`) therefore applies twice. The root's inline height wins on the root; the child has no inline height and stays 14rem, so the `height` config sizes an empty frame around a fixed slide area, and the 15 px padding is doubled.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: the `height` and `width` configs of `Neo.component.Base`, which size the component; nothing documents a fixed slide area.

- `Carousel.css` sizes `.neo-carousel` (14rem), `.neo-carousel-inner` (9rem) and `.neo-carousel-item` (9rem).
- The theme folders (`resources/css/theme-*/component/Carousel.css`) set only variables.

## The Fix

- Give the child element its own class (for example `neo-carousel-body`) instead of a second `neo-carousel`.
- Keep the 14rem default and the padding on the root only; let the body fill the root (a flex column), and the inner area take the space the button bar leaves.
- Keep `.neo-carousel-item` filling the inner area, so a slide grows with the carousel.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Only the root carries `neo-carousel`.
- [ ] AC-2: In `examples/component/carousel`, moving the height field from 200 to 800 makes the slides grow with the box; with no height set, the carousel keeps today's 14rem look.
- [ ] AC-3: A unit or component spec pins AC-1 and AC-2's sizing.

## Out of Scope

- New carousel features (indicators, swipe).
- The example's slides themselves (a separate change gives them images).

## Related

`examples/component/carousel` works around this with its own stylesheet in #21464 (Lists & Galleries part 2); once this lands, that override can go.
